I said that I made a decision but there is no decision as to how that works, so you're running ahead a little bit. Because what we're stating is that we are publishing the data model. Somewhere. And the small application has to get it. Now, is that a DB file? Or not? Those are decisions we haven't talked about. Are we running it on [SQLite]? What's the value of that? These things are to be considered.

Yes, SQLite is not the answer, I think, to the object model discussed in [OpenLight]. We're talking about remotes here. Talking about these things.
